name: comp-91
blurb: Interactive button that shows a spinner and disables on click, resets after 1 second.
description: A stateful button that triggers a loading state on click. Text hides and spinner appears while disabled. Resets after simulated async operation.
use_when: Indicating async form submissions or operations with built-in loading feedback.
avoid_when: When you need more control over loading state or longer operations.
a11y: Button is disabled during loading. Text is hidden but icon is aria-hidden.
